cycle_goal: Audit current Trigger-2 training artifacts against latest canonical authority and current external research; mark stale/superseded/blocked/current artifacts; feed only evidence-supported deltas into the living training design without minting training or J-Space credit.
canonical_observations: Supervisor 8.78 blocks trigger2_binding_router_factorial_generator_v3 from direct training because its deterministic display-order schedule is target-conditioned and leaks target class through model-visible nuisance combinations.

The v3 audit measured 0/127 nuisance signatures with all three target classes possible, 110/127 signatures with only one possible target class, nuisance-signature lookup accuracy 0.8819444444 and conditional MI 1.3488513896 bits. These are generator diagnostics, not model accuracy claims.

Current v2.2 proof-topology binder is METHOD_ONLY with 11,664 logical rows, full S3 mapping crossing, six display orders, direct/inverted polarity, three proof topologies and three focus positions; it remains training_eligible=false until exact checkpoint-local atom/tokenizer materialization and final split/shortcut gates pass.

Open PR #2007 identifies a proof-object defect in the in-generator nuisance decoder and proposes a model-visible semantic-ablation gate that preserves codebook/routing nuisance surfaces while masking only semantic evidence. It is an open candidate, not canonical main.

The variable-N fusion remains a method-level extension for the actual owner target: the binder must compose with DB-vs-simulation, variable-N cognition and Claude handoff/re-entry rather than becoming a standalone label-remapping benchmark.

external_research_delta.claim_used: Fine-tuning on arbitrary-symbol input-label mappings can improve following flipped labels and reduce reliance on natural-language label semantics.
external_research_delta.training_implication: KEEP arbitrary episode-local symbols and explicit mapping remaps as a central supervised family; do not regress to fixed semantic labels.
external_research_delta.evidence_boundary: PaLM-family result; does not prove Qwen3.5-0.8B behavior.

external_research_delta.claim_used: Small/medium open models can remain strongly anchored to pretrained label semantics under inverted demonstrations, making semantic override a distinct capability rather than a trivial ICL behavior.
external_research_delta.training_implication: ADD a frozen semantic-override/label-inversion stress metric to pre/post training evaluation; require arbitrary-symbol and inverted-polarity generalization rather than assuming episode-local remapping emerges automatically.
external_research_delta.evidence_boundary: Cross-model study; not a Qwen3.5-specific causal result.

external_research_delta.claim_used: Task-relevant information can emerge as compact representations and auxiliary objectives can strengthen task-vector localization/generalization in controlled transformers.
external_research_delta.training_implication: ADD post-training representation-probe and transfer diagnostics for episode-local binder state, but DO NOT add positive hidden-state/J-Space supervision until same-selected-model causal evidence exists.

external_research_delta.claim_used: Target-permutation non-equivariance creates an equivariance gap; explicit target-equivariant design can remove permutation-induced instability.
external_research_delta.training_implication: PROMOTE full-S3 orbit evaluation to a first-class binder criterion: report orbit-exact rate, worst-permutation accuracy and equivariance violations. Candidate future loss: an S3-equivariance consistency term across counterfactual codebook permutations, preregistered as a challenger rather than assumed beneficial.
external_research_delta.evidence_boundary: Tabular prior-fitted model result; architectural analogy only until tested on Qwen3.5 binder.

external_research_delta.claim_used: Transformer shortcut reliance can be detected/mitigated by explicitly probing undesired features rather than trusting aggregate accuracy.
external_research_delta.training_implication: KEEP nuisance-only challenger, conditional support/MI gates and worst-group diagnostics as pre-admission requirements; aggregate binder accuracy cannot promote a corpus/model by itself.
external_research_delta.evidence_boundary: General shortcut-learning evidence, not direct Trigger-2 validation.

external_research_delta.claim_used: SFT-induced changes/forgetting can be depth-dependent, with substantial sensitivity concentrated in later layers in the reported 1B-32B experiments.
external_research_delta.training_implication: ADD frozen layer-wise representation/behavior retention measurements to the full-FT experiment. Keep full-FT as owner target; treat layer-restricted tuning only as a scientific challenger/control, not as a silent target replacement.
external_research_delta.evidence_boundary: Cross-model result; exact Qwen3.5 layer behavior must be measured.

external_research_delta.claim_used: Qwen publishes an Apache-2.0 Qwen3.5-0.8B model and a separate Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base model surface.
external_research_delta.training_implication: Before materialization/training, freeze exact chosen repository, immutable revision, tokenizer/config/weight digests and runtime build; do not transfer atom geometry or hidden-state coordinates across checkpoints by name similarity.
external_research_delta.evidence_boundary: Availability/identity only; no project-specific capability credit.
